title: Sammy the Squirrel's Lost Acorn: Why Listening Matters!

lines.text: Sammy the squirrel loved leaping from high oak branches across the sunny park!
lines.caps: Sammy the squirrel loved *LEAPING | from high oak branches across the *SUNNY | *PARK!

lines.text: Be careful near the windy bridge! warned Mama Squirrel with a loving smile.
lines.caps: Be careful near the *WINDY | bridge! warned Mama Squirrel with a *LOVING | *SMILE!

lines.text: I'm a big boy now, I don't need warnings! Sammy chattered, dashing across the planks!
lines.caps: I'm a big boy *NOW, | I don't need warnings! Sammy chattered, dashing *ACROSS | the *PLANKS!

lines.text: WHOOSH! A giant gust of winter wind blew his prize acorn right off the edge!
lines.caps: *WHOOSH! A giant gust of winter *WIND | blew his prize acorn right *OFF | the *EDGE!

lines.text: Sammy scrambled and slipped, dangling by his tiny front paws!
lines.caps: Sammy scrambled and *SLIPPED, | dangling by his tiny *FRONT | *PAWS!

lines.text: Mama swung down with lightning speed, pulling him back to the safe, solid wood!
lines.caps: Mama swung down with *LIGHTNING | speed, pulling him back to the safe, *SOLID | *WOOD!

lines.text: Parents give warnings not to stop fun, but to protect you from unseen dangers!
lines.caps: Parents give warnings not to stop *FUN, | but to protect you from *UNSEEN | *DANGERS!

lines.text: Sammy hugged Mama tight and promised to always listen to her caring advice!
lines.caps: Sammy hugged Mama *TIGHT | and promised to always listen to her *CARING | *ADVICE!

lines.text: Listen and learn—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily adventures!
lines.caps: *LISTEN and learn— | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *ADVENTURES!
